question: 2021 to 2023 ANC coverage movement for these two: Gaya, Nalanda
gold_sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT district, year, 100.0 * anc4_completed / pregnancies_registered AS rate FROM anc_visits WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2021, 2023)) SELECT district, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN rate END), 1) AS change_pp FROM rates GROUP BY district ORDER BY district
sql_duckdb: SELECT (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.year = 2023 THEN T2.anc4_completed ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.year = 2023 THEN T1.pregnancies_registered ELSE 0 END), 0)) * 100 - (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.year = 2021 THEN T2.anc4_completed ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.year = 2021 THEN T1.pregnancies_registered ELSE 0 END), 0)) * 100 AS percentage_change FROM anc_visits AS T1 INNER JOIN anc_visits AS T2 ON T1.district = T2.district WHERE T1.district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND T1.year IN (2021, 2023)
